home.title: Welcome to DoofPlus
home.content: Manage batch traceability, quality events and regulatory evidence of your pharmaceutical laboratory in one place.

about.title: Quality and traceability for pharmaceutical laboratories
about.content: DoofPlus centralizes batch records, deviations and audit evidence so quality and production teams can comply with Good Manufacturing Practices without paperwork.

panel.platform-description: One workspace for quality and production

value.title: Built for regulated environments
value.subtitle: Every action is recorded so your laboratory is always ready for an audit.

traceability.title: Batch traceability
traceability.description: Follow each batch from raw materials to release.

monitoring.title: Real-time monitoring
monitoring.description: Track production status and quality alerts as they happen.

audit.title: Audit readiness
audit.description: Keep an immutable audit trail and generate regulatory reports.

workflow.title: From batch to release
workflow.description: DoofPlus supports the daily quality workflow of your laboratory.

items.1: Capture process data and record deviations.
items.2: Review and approve with electronic signatures.
items.3: Release the batch with complete evidence.

team.title: Made by IngesCompany
team.description: A team of Software Engineering students from UPC focused on digital solutions for the pharmaceutical industry.

overview.subtitle: Good morning, {{name}}. Prioritize risks, evidence and release decisions.
overview.deviations-note: Major deviations need a product-impact assessment

indicators.subtitle: Traceability completeness of closed batches and deviation trends to anticipate audit observations.
indicators.missing-note: Need records before the next audit
indicators.closed-note: Grouped by root cause and month
indicators.recurrent-note: 3 or more times in the quarter
indicators.gaps-text: Select a batch to see what is missing
indicators.by-cause: Deviations by root cause and month
indicators.recurrent-text: {{cause}} repeated {{count}} times this quarter (≥ 3), so it is flagged as recurrent. Linked CAPA: CAPA-26009.

documents.awaiting: Version {{version}} is awaiting Quality Manager approval
documents.awaiting-text: Version {{effective}} remains effective. Version {{version}} cannot be used operationally until approved by {{approver}}.
documents.author: Author

deviations.title: Deviation report & detail
deviations.routes: Routes to QA review · does not release the batch
deviations.evidence-required: All evidence must be reviewed before the assessment routes to QA approval.
deviations.required: Required fields · QC submits for review · QA approves disposition
deviations.all-evidence: All evidence must be attached and reviewed before submission routes to QA approval.
deviations.disposition-text: Product impact pending. QC submits results; an authorized QA approves the disposition. Batch release remains blocked.

capa.title: CAPA plan
capa.effectiveness: Effectiveness must be demonstrated before closure
capa.cannot-route: The plan cannot be routed for approval

rejected.evidence-missing: Attach the evidence of every action.
rejected.self-approval: The independent reviewer cannot be the plan owner.

capa.check-text: {{reviewer}} reviews 10 batch temperature traces and maintenance records.
capa.closure-text: All actions complete, evidence approved and acceptance criterion met. A failed effectiveness check reopens this plan.
capa.required-text: All items are required before routing the plan.
capa.uploaded-count: {{count}} of {{total}} items uploaded · approval blocked until all are attached

release.released: {{code}} was released with an electronic signature.
release.ready-text: You are authorized to sign. Confirm the record version and signing meaning before release.
release.blocked-text: Every readiness check must pass before the release can be signed.

checks.manufacturing-record-text: All operations of the order completed
checks.analytical-results-text: Every test within specification and approved
checks.materials-text: All input lots released from quarantine
checks.documents-text: Effective SOPs and trained operators verified

release.meaning-value: I approve this batch for release
release.meaning-fixed: Meaning is fixed and bound to this record.
release.wrong-password: The password is incorrect. The batch was not released.
release.no-privilege: Your role has no batch-release privilege.
release.sign-note: The signature is applied only after you re-enter your password.
release.approver-text: Distinct from the QC result submitter and from Production. The batch-release grant is explicit for the plant.
release.attribution-text: Signing meaning, approver identity and UTC timestamp are retained with the record.

results.subtitle: Results are calculated automatically with the formula of the approved analytical protocol and compared with the specification.
results.formula-from: Formula from PRT-QC-012 v4 · calculated by the system
results.oos-subtitle: Calculated result is outside the specified range
results.oos-text: Result {{result}} is outside {{spec}}. The result was recorded as OOS and a deviation must be registered before the batch can be released.
results.release-blocked: Blocked until the deviation is closed
results.no-oos-text: Every calculated result of this batch is within its specification.

trail.subtitle: Attributed record events with before/after values and controlled exports.
trail.retention-text: Organization policy applies. Users cannot edit or delete event entries; every export is recorded.

reports.subtitle: Generate evidence-backed reports for internal review, audits and DIGEMID inspections.
reports.library-text: {{count}} reports · internal auditors have read-only access
reports.dossier-text: Distribution is blocked until all the required evidence is approved
reports.completeness-text: Incomplete reports carry a Draft watermark and cannot be distributed.
reports.no-certification-text: DoofPlus supports controlled workflows; validation and regulatory obligations remain the laboratory's responsibility.
reports.permissions-text: QA specialists create and edit reports. Internal auditors have read-only access to the evidence packages.

tasks.subtitle: Assign accountable owners, request approvals between areas and keep each discussion linked to its record.
tasks.inbox-text: Tasks assigned to you and to your team
tasks.new-text: Notifies the owner by email and in-app
tasks.title: Task
tasks.discussion-text: Comments keep author and UTC timestamp; they are not approvals
tasks.comment-placeholder: Add a comment… (not an approval or signature)
tasks.record-access-text: Only authorized members can view the evidence and the discussion.
tasks.attribution-text: Comments keep author and UTC timestamp; mentions notify the recipient.
tasks.not-approval-text: Approvals and releases require an electronic signature in their own screen.
